name: grype
description: Container and filesystem vulnerability scanner with comprehensive CVE database and policy enforcement

grype.description: Vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems with SARIF/JSON output and policy enforcement
grype.usage:
grype alpine:latest
grype dir:. -o json
grype docker.io/nginx:latest --fail-on high
grype registry:busybox:latest -o sarif
grype . --only-fixed -o table
